nodes.description: Constant uint256 'prize' (0.05 ether) used as the minimum funding threshold checked in the constructor.
Public dynamic address array 'friends' that records every caller who plays the game.
Payable constructor that requires msg.value >= prize so the contract is funded with at least the prize amount.
Public game function: records msg.sender in friends, enforces msg.sender == tx.origin, then transfers the whole contract balance to msg.sender.
Untrusted external caller address; used for the friends push, the tx.origin comparison and as the recipient of the balance transfer.
Untrusted transaction origin used as an 'anti-bot' authorization source in the require(msg.sender == tx.origin) check.
External value transfer 'payable(msg.sender).transfer(address(this).balance)' sending the entire contract balance to an untrusted address.
Authorization check 'require(msg.sender == tx.origin, "no robots")'; using tx.origin for access decisions is an access-control anti-pattern vulnerable to phishing.

edges.reason: msg.sender is written into the friends state array via friends.push(msg.sender).
msg.sender is the recipient of an external balance transfer, creating an untrusted external call/ether-sending relation.
msg.sender is compared against tx.origin inside the authorization require statement.
tx.origin is used as the authorization source in the require check, enabling tx.origin-based access control bypass.
winPrizeAndFeelGoodAboutSelf executes the tx.origin require check before paying out.
The game function mutates the friends state variable on every call.
The game function performs the external balance transfer to msg.sender.
The constructor reads the prize constant to enforce msg.value >= prize.
